name: STIHL MSA 161 T
blurb: Battery top-handle. One 2025-chart row: 12″ bar, 1/4″ PICCO, .043″ gauge, 65 drive links (71 PM3 65).
intro: The MSA 161 T is a battery top-handle saw. STIHL's 2025 battery chart lists one combination: a 12″ bar, 71 PM3 65, which is 1/4″ PICCO at .043″ gauge with 65 drive links. The gauge and pitch come from the marketing number as defined on the identifying panel printed in the same catalog.

bars.note: STIHL's chart lists chain 71 PM3 65 with recommended bar 3005 008 3405. 1/4″ PICCO, .043″ gauge. The marketing number starts with 71: the Identifying STIHL Saw Chain panel on the same catalog pages defines 7 as 1/4″ PICCO and 1 as .043″. STIHL's 2025 file table lists a 3.2 mm (1/8″) file for 1/4″ PICCO.

sources.title: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog: Saw Chain Selection and Identification (catalog pages 166–167), including the file table and the Identifying STIHL Saw Chain panel

sources_note: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog, battery-saw chain chart and Identifying STIHL Saw Chain panel (catalog pp. 166–167), read 5 Nov 2026.
